mapper.insert: insert into pcd_file_info_table(file_id, file_name, file_uploaded_time, file_size, file_type, file_author_id, file_checksum, file_node_id, file_total_chunks, file_storage_path) values(#{id}, #{name}, #{uploaded_time}, #{size}, #{type}, #{user_id}, #{checksum}, #{node_id}, #{total_chunks}, #{storage_path});
mapper.select: select * from pcd_file_info_table where file_node_id = #{node_id} and file_author_id = #{user_id};
select * from pcd_file_info_table where file_node_id = #{node_id} and file_name = #{name} and file_author_id = #{user_id};
mapper.update: update pcd_file_info_table set file_name = #{file_new_name} where file_id = #{file_id} and file_author_id = #{user_id};
update pcd_file_info_table set file_node_id = #{target_node_id} where file_id = #{file_id} and file_author_id = #{user_id};
mapper.delete: delete from pcd_file_info_table where file_id = #{file_id} and file_author_id = #{user_id};
